newsitem.title: USA: Tetra gets contract worth up to $250 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tetra gets contract worth up to $250 mln.

text.p: Tetra Tech Inc said Tuesday it signed a contract with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency with a potential value of some $250 million over 10 years.
This contract is one of several contracts awarded earlier this year and announced in February.
The company will provide scientific and engineering services in support of the agency's Superfund program.
Tetra Tech provides environmental services, including research and development, assessment and engineering, design and construction management.
